expression:
fetch(issued.uploadUrl, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/pdf" },
      body: new Blob(
        [
          `%PDF-1.4
1 0 obj
<< /Type /Catalog >>
endobj
trailer
<< /Root 1 0 R >>
%%EOF
QA resume upload ${suffix}
`,
        ],
        { type: "application/pdf" },
      ),
    })

applications.map(async (app) => ({
        ...app,
        resumeUrl: await ctx.storage.getUrl(app.resumeStorageId),
        customAnswersCount: app.customAnswers?.length ?? 0,
        locationMismatchDisplay: computeLiveLocationMismatch(
          job,
          app,
          locationMismatchContextFromRecords(job, app),
        ),
        queueState: app.queueState ?? "active",
      }))
initializer:
typeof args.limit === "number"
        ? await ctx.db
            .query("applications")
            .withIndex("by_jobId_submittedAt", (q) => q.eq("jobId", args.jobId))
            .order("desc")
            .take(Math.min(1000, Math.max(1, args.limit)))
        : await ctx.db
            .query("applications")
            .withIndex("by_jobId", (q) => q.eq("jobId", args.jobId))
            .coll
